properties.desc: Radioactive slag / slag-like material in historic fill. Gamma survey (Ludlum 2221) measured >10,000 cpm here vs 6,000–8,000 cpm site background; gamma/alpha spectroscopy identified uranium, thorium and radium as the contributing radionuclides. Delineated in the 2012 Revised RI (Figure 3) as a soil-excavation target — a soil/slag hot zone, not a groundwater plume.
properties.source: NYSDEC BCP C932150 Revised RI Report (ERM, 2012), Figure 3 & §3.2.7
